Center.doc: Centers its children on both axes.

Col.doc:
Column inside a `Row`. `span`: columns of 12 (`span={"base": 12, "md": 6, "xl": 4}`), "auto" (content width)
or None (equal share). `span=0` hides it at that breakpoint. `offset` skips columns on the left. `align` is
align_self.

FlatList.doc:
RN FlatList. `renderItem({"item", "index", "separators"})`; `ref.current` has scrollToIndex / scrollToOffset /
scrollToEnd. `getItemLayout(data, index) -> {"length", "offset", "index"}` (or `item_size`) enables windowing.

Flex.doc:
Flexbox container with short props: `direction` ("row", "column", "row_reverse", "column_reverse"), `gap`,
`align` (align_items), `justify` (justify_content), `wrap` (True / "wrap" / "nowrap"), `grow` (flex). Each takes
a breakpoint map: `Flex(direction={"base": "column", "md": "row"})` stacks on phones and lines up on wider
screens.

Grid.doc:
Equal-width columns that wrap into rows, like CSS grid `repeat(n, 1fr)`.

`columns`: a number or a breakpoint map (`{"base": 1, "sm": 2, "lg": 4}`). `min_item_width`: auto-fit as many
columns of at least that width as the grid's own width allows (CSS `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(w, 1fr))`).
`gap` / `row_gap` / `column_gap` space the cells. Wrap a child in `GridItem(span=2)` to span columns.
`align` is align_items for each row (default stretch: cells in a row share its height).

GridItem.doc: Cell of a `Grid` spanning `span` columns (a number or breakpoint map). The Grid sizes it.

HStack.doc: Children side by side, `spacing` apart, vertically centered.

Hide.doc: The opposite of `Show`: hides its children at matching breakpoints.

Image.doc:
Image from `source`: a path, an http(s) URL, a data: URI, `asset:name`, or `{"uri": ...}`.
RN props: resizeMode, tintColor (style), onLoad, onError, onLoadStart, onLoadEnd, blurRadius, fadeDuration.

KeyboardAvoidingView.doc:
Moves its content above the keyboard. `behavior`: "padding" | "height" | "position"; without one the view
is a plain View (as in RN).

Picker.doc:
`<Picker selectedValue onValueChange(value, index)>` with `Picker.Item` children. Tapping opens a native
single-choice dialog (`prompt` is its title).

Pressable.doc:
Touchable view. `style` may be a function of the press state; so may the single child.

Props: onPress, onPressIn, onPressOut, onLongPress, delayLongPress (ms, default 500), disabled, hitSlop,
android_ripple ({"color", "borderless", "radius"}), testID, accessibility*. A disabled Pressable fires nothing.

RefreshControl.doc:
Pull-to-refresh. Only meaningful as `ScrollView(refreshControl=RefreshControl(refreshing=..., onRefresh=...))`
(also FlatList / SectionList). Props: refreshing, onRefresh, colors, tintColor, progressBackgroundColor.

Row.doc:
Row of a 12-column grid (Bootstrap style). `Col(span=6)` children take 6/12 of the width and wrap to the next
line when the row is full. `gutter` is the space between columns and between lines; `gx` / `gy` set them
separately. `align` / `justify` are align_items / justify_content. All take breakpoint maps.

SafeAreaView.doc:
View inset by the system bars, notch and home indicator (`react-native-safe-area-context` API).
`mode`: "padding" (default) or "margin".

ScrollView.doc:
Scrollable container. RN props: horizontal, contentContainerStyle, onScroll, scrollEventThrottle,
showsVerticalScrollIndicator, showsHorizontalScrollIndicator, bounces, pagingEnabled, scrollEnabled,
keyboardShouldPersistTaps, keyboardDismissMode, stickyHeaderIndices, refreshControl, contentOffset,
onContentSizeChange, onScrollBeginDrag, onScrollEndDrag, onMomentumScrollEnd, nestedScrollEnabled.
`ref.current` has scrollTo({x, y, animated}) and scrollToEnd({animated}).

SectionList.doc:
RN SectionList: `sections=[{"title", "data", "renderItem"?, "keyExtractor"?}]`. `renderItem` gets
`{"item", "index", "section", "separators"}`; the section renderers get `{"section"}`. Sticky headers are not
supported yet.

Show.doc:
Renders its children only at matching breakpoints: `Show(Sidebar(), above="lg")` from lg up,
`below="md"` under md, `only="md"`. Hidden children are unmounted (use a `display` breakpoint map in a style to
keep them mounted).

Slider.doc: Platform slider (`@react-native-community/slider` API). Controlled: update `value` in `onValueChange`.

Spacer.doc: Takes the free space in a Flex/HStack/VStack (or a fixed `size` in dp).

StatusBar.doc:
Declarative status bar; the newest mounted one wins. `barStyle`: "default" | "light-content" |
"dark-content". `backgroundColor` / `translucent` are Android only.

Switch.doc: Platform switch. `trackColor` / `thumbColor` take one colour or RN's `{False: off, True: on}`.

TextInput.doc:
Single- or multi-line text field. RN props: value, defaultValue, onChangeText, onChange,
onSubmitEditing, onFocus, onBlur, onEndEditing, onSelectionChange, onKeyPress, onContentSizeChange, placeholder,
placeholderTextColor, multiline, numberOfLines, maxLength, editable, secureTextEntry, keyboardType, returnKeyType,
autoCapitalize, autoCorrect, autoFocus, selectTextOnFocus, selectionColor, textAlign, style. `ref.current` has
focus(), blur(), clear(), setSelection(start, end).

TouchableHighlight.doc: Shows `underlayColor` behind the content and dims the content to `activeOpacity` while pressed.

VStack.doc: Children stacked top to bottom, `spacing` apart.

View.doc:
Layout container (flexbox). RN props: style, onLayout, pointerEvents, hitSlop, testID, nativeID,
accessibility*, plus the raw touch events onTouchStart/Move/End.

VirtualizedList.doc: RN VirtualizedList: FlatList over any `data` read through `getItem(data, index)` / `getItemCount(data)`.

title.description: Page title; default the app name.

size.description: Window size [width, height] in pixels at 100% scale; default [1024, 768].

title.description: Window title; default the app name.

Animated.doc: Animated: native-driven animations (Value, timing, spring, decay, composition) and Easing.

App.doc: Owns a reconciler and a channel. Batches setState into one flush per loop tick.

AppState.doc: `AppState.currentState` is "active" or "background"; `change` listeners get the new state.

Center.doc: Centers its children on both axes.

Channel.doc: Python <-> native transport. Both directions carry JSON strings.

Element.doc: Immutable-by-convention description of a UI node. `type` is a host name (str) or a Component.

create_app.doc: Mount without an event loop (synchronous flushes). Used by tests and tooling.

memo.doc: Skip re-rendering `comp` when its props are unchanged (shallow ==). Use `use_callback` for handlers.

processColor.doc: Return color as 0xAARRGGBB int. Accepts int, #rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(), names.

responsive.doc: Responsive breakpoints, like CSS media queries, on every platform.

run_app.doc:
Run the app on the current platform. Desktop target draws into a browser app window (PYXPO_RENDERER=console:
text tree in the terminal).

useAnimatedValue.doc: A Value that lives as long as the component. Freed natively on unmount.

useAsync.doc: Run fn (coroutine fn, or blocking fn in a worker thread) when deps change. Returns (loading, value, error).

useBreakpoint.doc:
Active responsive breakpoint ("xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl", "xxl" by default, see `pyxpo.responsive`).
Re-renders only when the window crosses a breakpoint.

useBreakpointValue.doc:
The value of a breakpoint map for the current window, mobile first:
`use_breakpoint_value({"base": 1, "md": 2, "xl": 4})`. A plain value comes back as is.

useDeferredValue.doc: pyxpo has no concurrent rendering: the value is returned as is.

useEffect.doc: Run fn after commit. deps=None: every render. deps=[]: once. fn may return a cleanup callable.

useId.doc: A string id that is stable for the life of the component and unique within the app.

useImperativeHandle.doc: Expose `create()` on a parent's ref (`ref.current`, or a callable ref). Cleared on unmount.

useLayoutEffect.doc: Same timing as `use_effect`: native layout is measured asynchronously, so there is no earlier point to run.

useMediaQuery.doc:
CSS-like media query against the window: `use_media_query("md")` is True from md up,
`use_media_query(down="lg")` below lg, `use_media_query(only="md")`, `use_media_query(min_width=600)`,
`use_media_query(orientation="landscape")`. Conditions combine with AND. Re-renders only when the result flips.

useReducer.doc:
`state, dispatch = use_reducer(reducer, initial_arg, init=None)`. dispatch is stable; a reducer result that is
the same as the current state does not re-render.

useSafeAreaFrame.doc: `{"x", "y", "width", "height"}` of the safe-area root in dp.

useSyncExternalStore.doc:
Read an external store. `subscribe(on_change)` returns an unsubscribe callable; `get_snapshot()` returns the
current value (it must return the same object while the store is unchanged).

useTransition.doc: `(is_pending, start_transition)`. pyxpo renders synchronously, so is_pending is always False.

use_animated_value.doc: A Value that lives as long as the component. Freed natively on unmount.

use_async.doc: Run fn (coroutine fn, or blocking fn in a worker thread) when deps change. Returns (loading, value, error).

use_breakpoint.doc:
Active responsive breakpoint ("xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl", "xxl" by default, see `pyxpo.responsive`).
Re-renders only when the window crosses a breakpoint.

align_content.doc: Lines across the main axis when `flex_wrap` makes more than one.

align_self.doc: This view across its parent's main axis (overrides the parent's `align_items`).

allow_font_scaling.doc: Text follows the system font size (default True).

background_color.doc: Color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba() or a name.

color.doc: Color: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba() or a name.

display.doc: `none` hides the view and takes it out of layout.

flex.doc: Share of the free space along the main axis (RN meaning: positive grows and shrinks).

flex_basis.doc: Size along the main axis before growing or shrinking.

font_family.doc: A system family or a font loaded with `use_fonts` / `[tool.pyxpo]` fonts.

linear_gradient.doc: Background gradient: `{"colors": [...], "angle": 180, "stops": [0, 1]}`. Angle 0 points up, 90 right, 180 down (default). `stops` are optional, 0..1, one per color.

number_of_lines.doc: Text: cut after this many lines (0 = no limit).

overflow.doc: `hidden` clips children to the view's bounds.

position.doc: `absolute` places the view by `top`/`right`/`bottom`/`left` inside its parent.

transform.doc: List of single-key dicts, as in RN: `[{"rotate": "45deg"}, {"scale": 1.2}]`.
